title: Eliminate Poachers returns for later servers
summary: A new Eliminate Poachers event entry opens for servers 277 and up, while the existing entry is capped to servers 144-276. The Purify Meowdame entries now show in the activity calendar with rewards attached.
highlights: New Eliminate Poachers activity (id 1511006) for servers 277-9999, unlocking at main level 8.
The earlier Eliminate Poachers entry (id 1511002) now covers servers 144-276 instead of 144 and up.
Purify Meowdame (ids 2731001-2731003) is now shown rather than hidden, gains a calendar icon, and lists its rewards.
